common.batch: 8 x grad-accum 3 = 24 / optimizer step, 1 GPU per arm
common.optimizer: AdamW lr 1e-5 fp32 master weights, bf16 autocast
common.eval: configs/eval_prompts.jsonl, test split, gen seeds 11 22 33 44 55 66 77 88 (protocol v2, locked 2026-11-10; v1 = first four), 30 steps, CFG 7.5
common.judge: ImageNet ConvNeXt-Base concept groups (primary auto), ViT-B/16 SWAG (second auto judge, Cohen's kappa), CLIP L/14 (screen)
common.statistics: two-level bootstrap over training seeds (paired when shared) and test prompts; Gate 3 Bonferroni over controls

arms.O: oracle_poison_removal (ground-truth labels; upper bound, NOT a defense or a control to beat)
arms.KB: rtw_on_clean_data (cost of the defense when there is no attack)

N7c.status: post-hoc addition 2026-11-13: lambda 0 poisons (C 0.156), lambda 1 does not (C 0.956); reported as gate4_extended next to the pre-registered Gate 4

N6b.status: post-hoc addition 2026-11-13: replicate the seed-42 result G 0.000 vs K 0.975 / J 0.988

N5b.attack: car2cow_eps08 (official Nightshade, eps 0.08, same 200 car records)
N5b.status: post-hoc, prepared 2026-11-13; chained only if car + car_seeds confirm the eps 0.04 car attack is weak (seed 42: C car 0.794, cow 0.006; B 0.95)

gates.2: acc(C) < acc(B), 95% CI of B-C excludes 0
gates.3: candidate (K, KE, RS, V or F) > every available control in (C,D,E,G,H,I,J,LF,M1,M2), Bonferroni-adjusted paired CI excl. 0; non-target accuracy non-inferior to B (margin 0.05); KID/diversity within B CI (prompt-level subsampling CI of the difference)
gates.4: holds for N10 (>= 3 seeds), N5 (car) and every N7 lambda (K - C > 0, or the adaptive attack fails Gate 2); scripts/attack_tradeoff.py

policy: only publicly available code; LightShed excluded (request-only); IMPRESS / GrIDPure / PDM-Pure not run (third-party code not provenance-checked)
